title: Data Center Engineer
description:
Summary:

The engineer in this position should have a wealth of experience engineering/installing datacenter equipment. The engineer will typically take on the more complex work and pull all aspects of a job together into a cohesive package. This would include the complete engineering of data centers including, but not limited to, infrastructure, overhead and underfloor racking, cabinets, network and server equipment, cable distribution, power (AC or DC), Cold Aisle Containment solutions, etc.

Qualifications:

High School diploma is necessary. Some college or technical school a plus. At least 3 years engineering experience or equivalent field experience in a data center environment
BICSI certifications a plus
An advanced understanding of various software packages including MS Word, spreadsheet/database programs such as MS Excel, MS Access
Ability to quickly learn customer engineering databases and software.
Must be able to handle multiple tasks and priorities and must be able to consistently work under and meet strict deadlines.
Must possess good leadership, verbal, and written communication skills.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the most complex of documents, including technical specifications, white papers, data center drawings and documents.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to write engineering specifications.

Responsibilities:

  • work independently on deadline sensitive jobs or projects with little direction
  • read and understand site survey data, able to think through the information presented and quickly put together a bill of material with little guidance.
  • schedule, perform, and write-up site surveys when necessary
  • develop Bill of Materials and Firm Price Quotes
  • write complex data center specific engineering specifications which will include in
  • fix engineering problems and mistakes. Understands change order procedures and material billing issues.
  • Manage several engineering projects simultaneously
  • proficient with updating customer drawings and databases
  • takes an active role in teaching detail engineer procedures and philosophies of engineering.
  • regularly interfaces with customer representatives (field engineers, data center managers, data center technicians, local construction contractors, etc.
  • Should be at level where can solve customer problems issues with limited guidance
  • interface with "internal customers” such as field engineers, installation supervisors, lead installers, and installation techs. Guides detail engineer through problems and situations with "internal customers”
  • fully understand format and structure of an engineering specification.
  • working knowledge of equipment drawings, T-BASD drawings, and material spec sheets and white papers. Also has ability to seek out information not readily available
  • fully adept at drafting and updating customer drawings and using drafting programs such as VISIO and AUTOCAD
  • often will initiate site visits and site surveys. Visit site when necessary to solve problems
  • able to engineer jobs using a full understanding of customer quality documents such as Installation Practices, Engineering Practices, BICSI standard documents, etc...
  • Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

Engineering Skills and Reasoning Ability:
  • Ability to logically think through the process of telecommunication installation and engineering.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical specifications in order to translate such information into a detailed engineering spec. Ability to apply principles of logic to a wide range of intellectual, technical, and practical problems.
  • Ability to use common engineering tools effectively such as a tape measure, calculator, power lead calculator, etc.

Physical Demands:

  • The employee will be required to use his/her hands 90% of the time to type, write, and handle paperwork.
  • The employee will be sitting at a desk 80% of the time with walking between offices and other work areas from time to time. At times, employee is required to make customer visits to resolve problems or provide customer service.
  • The employee may, from time to time, be required to lift weight (i.e., paper boxes) up to 15 pounds.
  • Close vision (clear vision at 20 inches or less) is generally required, as the employee will be working at a computer and working with files & paperwork.

title: Computer Systems Analyst
description:
Assist and/or install, deploy, and test new security operations and other cyber security related support systems. A full and thorough knowledge of modern cyber security computer systems and applications must be maintained to be able to quickly collect data to back up decisions you will make.

Computer Systems Analyst Responsibilities:
  • Consult with colleagues about their IT needs.
  • Assist in testing and implementing cyber security hardware and software technologies typically used by our SOC (security operations center) staff, to decide if they offer improvements.
  • Assist the management team in deciding if the evaluated system meets the expectations of the IT systems and infrastructure upgrades to ensure that it makes business sense.

title: Administrative Assistant- Staffing
description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly skilled Bilingual Executive Assistant to support our Chief Financial Officer (CFO). The ideal candidate will have prior experience as an executive assistant, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high -pressure environment. This role requires fluency in English and Korean to effectively support the CFO and coordinate with global stakeholders.
This is an in-person position, 5 days in the office located in Englewood Cliffs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned:

title: RF Engineer Principal
description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

Summary: A Principal RF Engineer is a senior-level engineering professional who designs and develops radio frequency (RF) systems and components. They are responsible for overseeing the development of complex RF systems and ensuring their performance meets project requirements.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned:

  • RF System Design: responsible for designing and developing RF systems for a variety of applications, including wireless communications, radar, and satellite communications.
  • Technical Leadership: Will provide technical leadership and guidance to other RF engineers, ensuring that designs meet performance requirements and are delivered on time and within
  • System Integration: Will work closely with other engineers to integrate RF systems with other components, including hardware and software.
  • Test and Evaluation: Will oversee the testing and evaluation of RF systems, ensuring that they meet performance requirements and are reliable and efficient.
  • Troubleshooting: Will be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving complex RF design and testing issues and providing technical support to other engineers and technicians.
  • Documentation: Will be responsible for creating and maintaining technical documentation, including design specifications, test plans, and reports.
  • Innovation: expected to stay up to date with the latest developments in RF technology, and to incorporate new and innovative ideas into
  • Customer Interaction: Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and to provide technical expertise and support throughout the development process.
  • Project Management: Responsible for managing projects, including defining project scope, developing schedules, and ensuring that project deliverables are met on time and within

Mentoring: responsible for mentoring and training other engineers, helping to develop their technical skills and knowledge.

SAFETY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adhere to, promote, and accept personal responsibility for compliance to:
  • Federal and Local Occupational Safety and Health Regulations
  • Industry Consensus Standards
  • Circet USA Injury and Illness Prevention Program Manual
  • Participate in job site safety/hazard analysis

Qualifications

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, and/or QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field is required.
  • Experience: At least 10-15 years of experience in RF design, analysis, and testing is required.
  • Technical Skills: strong technical background in RF design, analysis, and testing is requiredas well as proficiency in using software tools such as MATLAB, ADS, and HFSS. Experience with network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and other RF test equipment is also important.
  • Leadership Skills: strong leadership skills and experience leading teams of engineers and technicians.
  • Project Management Skills: experience in project management, including defining project scope, developing schedules, and ensuring that project deliverables are met on time and within budget.
  • Communication Skills: excellent communication skillsto work with cross-functional teams, including hardware, software, and system engineers. Require ability to clearly articulate technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: strong problem-solving skills, as the position is responsible for troubleshooting and resolving complex RF design and testing issues.
  • Attention to Detail: strong attention to detail, as even small design or testing errors can have significant consequences in RF systems.
  • Innovation: have a passion for innovation and keeping up with the latest developments in RF technology.
  • Professional Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Wireless Network Professional (CWNP) or National Instruments Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD) can be a plus, although not always required. Additionally, a RF Principal may be required to have security clearances for certain government or defense-related projects.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS/ REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Ability to read, analyze and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports and legal documents; ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies or members of the business community; ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from Executive Management, public groups clients and/or customers.

Able to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists; ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Network Planning Engineer (Telecom Circuit Design)
description:
Network Planning Engineer (Telecom Circuit Design)

Resources will be required to work on client's site in Melbourne, FL.  Non-local candidates will be compensated accordingly for long-term assignment in Melbourne.

Job Description:

A Network Planning Engineer’s (Telco Engineer) role will be a crucial part in evaluating, planning, and implementing a cutting-edge telecommunications network design tailored to mission-critical needs. You will be at the forefront of replacing legacy copper-based systems with advanced technologies, creating scalable and optimized telco architectures, and documenting solutions that support engineering and NOC operations. Collaborate with internal and external teams, work independently on high-impact projects, and lead proof-of-concept efforts for emerging services.

Essential Functions:
  • Assess telecommunications technologies and design solutions to ensure alignment with the network’s critical infrastructure and service requirements.
  • Architect and engineer next-generation telco services to replace legacy copper-based solutions with modern, scalable alternatives.
  • Deliver tailored network implementations that meet dynamic customer requirements and long-term strategic objectives.
  • Establish and apply best practices in network design, capacity planning, and service continuity to support mission-critical operations.
  • Oversee the telco design release lifecycle to ensure timely execution and alignment with program milestones.

  • Responsibilities:

    a. Evaluate telco designs in relation to the critical infrastructure and service needs for the FTI network.
    b. Plan and design modern telco services to replace legacy copper-based telco solutions.
    c. Implement solutions that support customer requirements.
    d. Participate in after action reviews to resolve technical challenges.
    e. Create and maintain documentation for engineering and NOC teams.
    f. Identify areas of opportunity for automation and network optimization.
    g. Manage the Telco design release workflow to meet the implementation schedule.

    Required Qualifications:

    a. Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems or equivalent of a 4-year accredited degree in a technical discipline
    b. Degree and minimum 4 years of prior WAN Telecommunications networks experience or 2 years post-Secondary/ Associates Degree and a minimum of 8 years of prior WAN Telecommunications networks experience
    c. Highly motivated and capable of developing and following detailed instructions and action plans.
    d. Ability to work in a team environment and is self-directed and self-motivated.
    e. Project management skills capable of adhering to deadlines and completing tasks per project schedule.
    f. Strong skill set with Microsoft Office software applications.
    g. Knowledge and understanding of engineering drawings and technical procedures.
    h. Domain knowledge of the Telecommunications industry, including carrier services, provisioning terminology, CISCO routers and network infrastructure and IP technologies such as Pseudo Wire and Ethernet switching.
    i. Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance security clearance.

    Preferred Additional Qualifications:

    a. Experience designing and implementing network technologies such as SONET, Carrier Ethernet, LTE...etc.

title: Level 3 Installer--Travel
description:
Level 3 Installers--Travel:
Must have, or be able to obtain, Real ID or Passport for nationwide air travel.

AT&T Experience needed

1. Must have Telecommunication Central Office expierance and be able to work independently
Have a minimum of 2 years accumulated experience, or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process and demonstrated to the TC representative upon request, proficiency in the system (Network Elements 1, 2, 3, or 4) being worked on, or hold a Certificate of Completion from a training facility providing an appropriate curriculum.
2. Be capable of performing the following work operations or job activities without supervision or direction:
  • Addition or removal of common systems equipment hardware.
  • Addition or removal of wiring and connections (on non-working equipment only).
  • Lead verification/continuity testing.
  • Analysis of job specifications and drawings.
  • Understand the Scope of Work (SOW) and write comprehensive Job Change Order (JCO) summaries.
  • Provide work assignments to Skill Level 1 and 2 Installers.
  • Prepare a Method of Procedure (MOP).
  • Write Job Information Memorandums (JIMs).
  • Resolve job specification and/or drawing problems.
  • Mark/correct office record drawings.
  • In-process and final quality inspections.

3. Be capable of performing as the Installation Supplier's in-charge person on Common Systems jobs.
4. Not perform Skill Level 4 work operations/job activities unless properly supervised.
5. Not progress to Skill Level 4 without a minimum of 6 years accumulated experience or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process.
6. Not perform work operations/job activities on working equipment or circuits unless directly supervised.

Requirements:
1. Must understand and know how to use Microsoft programs and applications on a PC and smart device.
2. Must understand Ethernet and Serial connection requirements and be able to establish PC to Network Elements communications using appropriate interface cable.
3. Must have a smart phone with picture capabilities and the ability to place applications used for work.
4. Must have a smart phone with "Mobile Hotspot” capabilities and the ability to establish smart phone to PC connections for the purpose of assisting with remote support via desktop sharing.
5. Must be able to work alone and with others in a fast-paced schedule.
6. Must be able to take direction and constructive criticism.
7. Must be able to think freely and overcome complex issues.
8. Ability to learn to run scripts and commands for test and turn-up of equipment.
9. Must be able to learn company and customer programs for data collection.
10. Must have the ability to fly and ability to travel 100% for 3 consecutive weeks or more with field breaks as the company needs allow.
11. Must pass criminal and drug tests to gain access badging from the telco customer.
12. Must be able to interface politely with the customer using proper work ethics and etiquette while working under pressure.
13. Must have the ability and aptitude to meet customer start and stop working hours.
14. Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces.
15. Must have their own telecom insulated hand tools. (See required tool kits below)
16. Understanding of proper cabling installation and protection techniques.
17. Understanding industry standards for securing cables using waxed 9-cord and Velcro.
18. Understanding of proper fiber types, ends, jumper/JPOI handling and protection.
19. Understanding of proper fiber cleaning and scoping techniques. (Will NOT be required to splice)
20. Knowledge and understanding of DWDM, OME long haul, short haul, up to 100G circuits.
21. Knowledge and understanding of mounting equipment in customer central offices, colocation areas, huts, and outdoor enclosures.
22. Ability to make and test Cat-5/6 cables straight and crossover.
23. Ability to see Understand the telecom color codes and wire wrap paired cable.
24. Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering documents, customer best practices, and manufacturer technical practices.
a. Scope of work
b. Cable run lists
c. Rack Face View (RFV) drawing
d. Signal Flow Diagram (SFD)
e. Circuit drawings
f. Installation instructions
g. Method Of Procedures (MOP) (E-MOPs)
25. Knowledge of AC and DC power. a. Power Bays, verifying and installing -48V and return leads while protecting live circuits.
b. Must be able to properly strip and crimp DC power leads.
c. Crimping of lugs and H-Taps.
d. Ability to terminate power safely.
e. Use of electrical grease where required.
f. Use of double insulated torque wrench and screwdriver.
g. Able to work steadily in an enclosed power environment.
h. Understanding of AC power and connections.
26. Knowledge of Telcordia GR1275 industry installation standards.
27. Telco equipment manufacturer and customer knowledge is a plus. a. Ciena
b. Cisco
c. Telecommunication
d. Comcast
e. Telecommunication
f. Enterprise customers
g. GCN customers
h. Etc.

title: Level 3 Installer--Travel
description:
Level 3 Installers--Travel:
Must have, or be able to obtain, Real ID or Passport for nationwide air travel.​​​​​​​
AT&T Experience needed

1. Must have Telecommunication Central Office expierance and be able to work independently
Have a minimum of 2 years accumulated experience, or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process and demonstrated to the TC representative upon request, proficiency in the system (Network Elements 1, 2, 3, or 4) being worked on, or hold a Certificate of Completion from a training facility providing an appropriate curriculum.
2. Be capable of performing the following work operations or job activities without supervision or direction:
  • Addition or removal of common systems equipment hardware.
  • Addition or removal of wiring and connections (on non-working equipment only).
  • Lead verification/continuity testing.
  • Analysis of job specifications and drawings.
  • Understand the Scope of Work (SOW) and write comprehensive Job Change Order (JCO) summaries.
  • Provide work assignments to Skill Level 1 and 2 Installers.
  • Prepare a Method of Procedure (MOP).
  • Write Job Information Memorandums (JIMs).
  • Resolve job specification and/or drawing problems.
  • Mark/correct office record drawings.
  • In-process and final quality inspections.

3. Be capable of performing as the Installation Supplier's in-charge person on Common Systems jobs.
4. Not perform Skill Level 4 work operations/job activities unless properly supervised.
5. Not progress to Skill Level 4 without a minimum of 6 years accumulated experience or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process.
6. Not perform work operations/job activities on working equipment or circuits unless directly supervised.

Requirements:
1. Must understand and know how to use Microsoft programs and applications on a PC and smart device.
2. Must understand Ethernet and Serial connection requirements and be able to establish PC to Network Elements communications using appropriate interface cable.
3. Must have a smart phone with picture capabilities and the ability to place applications used for work.
4. Must have a smart phone with "Mobile Hotspot” capabilities and the ability to establish smart phone to PC connections for the purpose of assisting with remote support via desktop sharing.
5. Must be able to work alone and with others in a fast-paced schedule.
6. Must be able to take direction and constructive criticism.
7. Must be able to think freely and overcome complex issues.
8. Ability to learn to run scripts and commands for test and turn-up of equipment.
9. Must be able to learn company and customer programs for data collection.
10. Must have the ability to fly and ability to travel 100% for 3 consecutive weeks or more with field breaks as the company needs allow.
11. Must pass criminal and drug tests to gain access badging from the telco customer.
12. Must be able to interface politely with the customer using proper work ethics and etiquette while working under pressure.
13. Must have the ability and aptitude to meet customer start and stop working hours.
14. Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces.
15. Must have their own telecom insulated hand tools. (See required tool kits below)
16. Understanding of proper cabling installation and protection techniques.
17. Understanding industry standards for securing cables using waxed 9-cord and Velcro.
18. Understanding of proper fiber types, ends, jumper/JPOI handling and protection.
19. Understanding of proper fiber cleaning and scoping techniques. (Will NOT be required to splice)
20. Knowledge and understanding of DWDM, OME long haul, short haul, up to 100G circuits.
21. Knowledge and understanding of mounting equipment in customer central offices, colocation areas, huts, and outdoor enclosures.
22. Ability to make and test Cat-5/6 cables straight and crossover.
23. Ability to see Understand the telecom color codes and wire wrap paired cable.
24. Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering documents, customer best practices, and manufacturer technical practices.
a. Scope of work
b. Cable run lists
c. Rack Face View (RFV) drawing
d. Signal Flow Diagram (SFD)
e. Circuit drawings
f. Installation instructions
g. Method Of Procedures (MOP) (E-MOPs)
25. Knowledge of AC and DC power. a. Power Bays, verifying and installing -48V and return leads while protecting live circuits.
b. Must be able to properly strip and crimp DC power leads.
c. Crimping of lugs and H-Taps.
d. Ability to terminate power safely.
e. Use of electrical grease where required.
f. Use of double insulated torque wrench and screwdriver.
g. Able to work steadily in an enclosed power environment.
h. Understanding of AC power and connections.
26. Knowledge of Telcordia GR1275 industry installation standards.
27. Telco equipment manufacturer and customer knowledge is a plus. a. Ciena
b. Cisco
c. Telecommunication
d. Comcast
e. Telecommunication
f. Enterprise customers
g. GCN customers
h. Etc.

title: IT Asset Application Rationalization / Renewal Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities:
Application Inventory & Assessment
• Maintain a comprehensive inventory of applications across business units.
• Evaluate applications based on usage, cost, business criticality, and technical compatibility.
Rationalization Strategy
• Identify redundant, obsolete, or underutilized applications.
• Recommend actions such as consolidation, retirement, replacement, or upgrade.
Stakeholder Engagement
• Collaborate with business units, IT teams, and enterprise architects to gather insights and validate findings.
• Facilitate workshops and interviews to understand application value and dependencies.
Data Analysis & Reporting
• Analyze application data to support rationalization decisions.
• Develop dashboards and reports to communicate findings and recommendations to leadership.
Cost Optimization
• Support efforts to reduce licensing, support, and infrastructure costs through rationalization.
• Track savings and efficiency gains from rationalization initiatives.
Governance & Compliance
• Ensure rationalization efforts align with IT governance, security, and compliance standards.
• Maintain documentation and audit trails for rationalization decisions.
Tool Utilization
• Use tools such as ServiceNow application portfolios.
• Support integration of rationalization data into broader ITAM and enterprise architecture systems.
Contract Lifecycle Management
• Maintain a centralized repository of IT contracts and renewal schedules.
• Track key dates, terms, and conditions for all IT-related agreements.
Renewal Planning & Execution
• Monitor upcoming contract expirations and initiate renewal processes.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to assess renewal needs and obtain approvals.
Vendor Engagement
• Communicate with vendors to obtain renewal quotes, updated terms, and negotiate pricing.
• Ensure service continuity and avoid lapses in support or licensing.
Usage & Compliance Analysis
• Review asset usage data to validate renewal quantities and ensure compliance.
• Identify opportunities to reduce costs through right-sizing or consolidation.
Reporting & Documentation
• Generate reports on renewal status, cost savings, and contract performance.
• Maintain audit-ready documentation of renewal decisions and approvals.
Process Optimization
• Recommend and implement improvements to the renewal workflow.
• Leverage ITAM tools - ServiceNow.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.
• 3+ years of experience in IT Asset Management, Application Portfolio Management, or Enterprise Architecture in ServiceNow.
• Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making.
• Familiarity with application lifecycle management and rationalization frameworks.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills:
• Experience with APM tools
• Basic Project Management
• Knowledge of cloud migration and modernization strategies.
• Understanding of ITIL.

title: OSP Construction Manager
description:
OSP Construction Manager

Job Description:
This position is responsible for overseeing OSP Construction activities performed by contractors. The Administrative Construction Manager is responsible to ensure contractor-produced work meets or exceeds quality standards and that projects are completed per design and within the allocated budget. This position requires strong communication skills, verbal and written, as projects will need to be coordinated with State and/or local municipalities as well with other utilities or departments. The Administrative Construction Manager ensures contractor compliance with State, local, and company requirements while working within the public ROW or utility easement. This position requires strong teamwork with the Construction Supervisor as well as the OSP Engineer. This position requires teaming cross-functionally with departments such as Logistics, Contract Administration, ISP Engineering/COE, and Project Management. This position also supports sales, marketing, operations, and regulatory as well as other duties assigned by the Manager or Director of Engineering.

Responsibilities:
• Familiarity with permitting requirements- Work Zone Protection (WZP) and Traffic Control plans (TCP)
• Project Scheduling- meet project timelines
• Project Inspections- pre and post
• Material Management
• Utilize the JIM process as necessary
• Ensure accurate reporting- invoicing/timesheets
• Maintain accurate records- asbuilts
• Attend pre-construction meetings
• Monitor project expenditures for accuracy and budget requirements
• Plant Damage investigation and reporting

Required Qualifications:
• Strong knowledge of OSP Construction Standards and Practices
• Strong knowledge of OSP Unit Descriptions and SSP contracts
• Strong knowledge of State, Local, and Company standards for Safety
• Minimum five years of combined Outside Plant construction and splicing experience
• Physical requirements include the ability to work out of doors in inclement weather, extended driving, and lifting and carrying of moderately heavy objects
• Candidates must be willing to work overtime, be on-call periodically for nights and weekends and work as required to accomplish goals and objectives
• Overnight travel may occasionally be required
• Valid driver's license is required

Must have, or be able to obtain, Real ID or Passport for nationwide air travel.
AT&T Experience needed

1. Must have Telecommunication Central Office expierance and be able to work independently
Have a minimum of 2 years accumulated experience, or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process and demonstrated to the TC representative upon request, proficiency in the system (Network Elements 1, 2, 3, or 4) being worked on, or hold a Certificate of Completion from a training facility providing an appropriate curriculum.
2. Be capable of performing the following work operations or job activities without supervision or direction:
  • Addition or removal of common systems equipment hardware.
  • Addition or removal of wiring and connections (on non-working equipment only).
  • Lead verification/continuity testing.
  • Analysis of job specifications and drawings.
  • Understand the Scope of Work (SOW) and write comprehensive Job Change Order (JCO) summaries.
  • Provide work assignments to Skill Level 1 and 2 Installers.
  • Prepare a Method of Procedure (MOP).
  • Write Job Information Memorandums (JIMs).
  • Resolve job specification and/or drawing problems.
  • Mark/correct office record drawings.
  • In-process and final quality inspections.

3. Be capable of performing as the Installation Supplier's in-charge person on Common Systems jobs.
4. Not perform Skill Level 4 work operations/job activities unless properly supervised.
5. Not progress to Skill Level 4 without a minimum of 6 years accumulated experience or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process.
6. Not perform work operations/job activities on working equipment or circuits unless directly supervised.

Requirements:
1. Must understand and know how to use Microsoft programs and applications on a PC and smart device.
2. Must understand Ethernet and Serial connection requirements and be able to establish PC to Network Elements communications using appropriate interface cable.
3. Must have a smart phone with picture capabilities and the ability to place applications used for work.
4. Must have a smart phone with "Mobile Hotspot” capabilities and the ability to establish smart phone to PC connections for the purpose of assisting with remote support via desktop sharing.
5. Must be able to work alone and with others in a fast-paced schedule.
6. Must be able to take direction and constructive criticism.
7. Must be able to think freely and overcome complex issues.
8. Ability to learn to run scripts and commands for test and turn-up of equipment.
9. Must be able to learn company and customer programs for data collection.
10. Must have the ability to fly and ability to travel 100% for 3 consecutive weeks or more with field breaks as the company needs allow.
11. Must pass criminal and drug tests to gain access badging from the telco customer.
12. Must be able to interface politely with the customer using proper work ethics and etiquette while working under pressure.
13. Must have the ability and aptitude to meet customer start and stop working hours.
14. Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces.
15. Must have their own telecom insulated hand tools. (See required tool kits below)
16. Understanding of proper cabling installation and protection techniques.
17. Understanding industry standards for securing cables using waxed 9-cord and Velcro.
18. Understanding of proper fiber types, ends, jumper/JPOI handling and protection.
19. Understanding of proper fiber cleaning and scoping techniques. (Will NOT be required to splice)
20. Knowledge and understanding of DWDM, OME long haul, short haul, up to 100G circuits.
21. Knowledge and understanding of mounting equipment in customer central offices, colocation areas, huts, and outdoor enclosures.
22. Ability to make and test Cat-5/6 cables straight and crossover.
23. Ability to see Understand the telecom color codes and wire wrap paired cable.
24. Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering documents, customer best practices, and manufacturer technical practices.
a. Scope of work
b. Cable run lists
c. Rack Face View (RFV) drawing
d. Signal Flow Diagram (SFD)
e. Circuit drawings
f. Installation instructions
g. Method Of Procedures (MOP) (E-MOPs)
25. Knowledge of AC and DC power. a. Power Bays, verifying and installing -48V and return leads while protecting live circuits.
b. Must be able to properly strip and crimp DC power leads.
c. Crimping of lugs and H-Taps.
d. Ability to terminate power safely.
e. Use of electrical grease where required.
f. Use of double insulated torque wrench and screwdriver.
g. Able to work steadily in an enclosed power environment.
h. Understanding of AC power and connections.
26. Knowledge of Telcordia GR1275 industry installation standards.
27. Telco equipment manufacturer and customer knowledge is a plus. a. Ciena
b. Cisco
c. Telecommunication
d. Comcast
e. Telecommunication
f. Enterprise customers
g. GCN customers
h. Etc.

title: Deployment Manager
description:
Deployment Manager:

The Deployment Manager will be responsible for leading and managing deployment projects within ASIT team.
This role ensures that projects are properly staffed, field technicians are supported and trained, and deployment activities align with overall business goals.

Scope of Work:

  • Ensures NA deployment projects are staffed with appropriate field technicians to execute the scope of work.
  • Works with service partners directly to help manage the day-to-day activities of the technicians.
  • Helps identify and work to train incoming resource to Ciena methods and standards also can guide technicians to online training and Ciena bootcamps to advance skill levels.
  • Coordinate between internal and external teams to ensure the techs are properly trained and equipped.
  • Can prepare detailed reports on field activity and report to senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Coordinates franchise PMs and deployment service partners to ensure all deployment projects are staffed appropriately every week
  • Interfaces with project management to determine weekly project start requirements
  • Interfaces with deployment partners to confirm resource availability
  • Interviews field technicians for tiger team support
  • Engages tiger teams to provide project support
  • Can interview technicians and determine qualifications
  • The Deployment Manager will be responsible for leading and managing deployment projects within ASIT team.
  • This role ensures that projects are properly staffed, field technicians are supported and trained, and deployment activities align with overall business goals.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field from a college or university with six to eight years related experience
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Strong management background able to manage many technicians.
  • Telecommunication background is a plus.

Ideal Candidate Profile:
  • Customer Focused - Acts to add value to customer relationships through concrete actions and decisions
  • Critical Thinking / Analysis- Analyzes Multi-dimensional problems; gathers information over extended periods of time and applies complex concepts to generate possible solutions
  • Judgment - Makes Complex decisions/Judgment considering multiple alternatives
  • Decisiveness - Delivers decisions in the face of completing alternatives
  • Developing Others - Creates Development Opportunities to foster the teams learning
  • Organizational Awareness - Understands formal and informal structure and the climate / culture of the organization
  • Understands JIT (Just in Time) concepts as they pertain to EF&I Field Projects
  • Outstanding planning, scheduling, and coordination skills
  • Is self-motivated and can work from high level departmental goals
  • A team player that will work well in a cross functional team environment
  • Must have proficiency with various software applications including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Microsoft Project, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, PowerBI and complex databases.

title: Quality Auditor
description:
Position Summary
Inspects, reports, and maintains independent analysis of customer installation projects. Inspection includes physical installation of telecommunication and transport equipment. Review and report quality of all Engineering Specifications & Installation packages to ensure that they are consistent with and meet all requirements of the customer. This is accomplished by performing audits during installation of the package and immediately after job end. Audits include all aspects of project from engineering and installation. The goal is to find and report issues so that a superior product is delivered to the customer.

This is considered a 100% travel throughout the US.
May require weekend work at times.
Telecom Quality inspection knowledge is a must.
5 plus years of telecom installation experience.
3 plus years of quality auditing experience. 

Major Responsibility
• Interprets Customer Standards / Practices, T-BASD Drawings, Flashes and Manufacturers and understands documentation of the National Electric Code, and other industry standard documents.
• Ensures engineering specification, assignments, and job drawings are in accordance with specifications and that proper documentation is provided.
• Audits engineering documentation and installation workmanship to ensure accuracy of the information presented.
• Develops a list of deltas for correction and verifies completed corrections per company standards.
• Audit customer job site on request, visually inspect pictures that have been uploaded to ensure that customer standards are met. Verify job spec information and documentation is properly and accurately collected and conveyed when necessary.
• Ability to be at the job site to audit installed equipment to ensure that customer standards are met.
• Must be AT&T certified or able to pass their tests to become certified.
• Knowledge of Ciena, Cisco, and other telecom equipment installation.
• Ability to train technicians while performing installation inspection.

Position Qualification / Requirements
• Computer skills, including Microsoft Office and other software applications.
• 3M & Hilti Fire Stop Certification or knowledge.
• Ability to fly or operate a motor vehicle, possess valid US Driver's License, and maintain an approved Motor Vehicle Record.
• Knowledge of Telecommunications and transport equipment installation.
• Handle confidential/sensitive information with discretion.
• Excellent communication & good judgment.
• Organizational skills.
• Customer service skills.
• Interpersonal skills.
• Knowledge of equipment installation, detail engineering, COAR, site survey, knowledge and understanding of power, grounding, and Telephony theory.
Key Words
• Telecommunications Quality
• Telecom Installation Quality
• Telcordia Bell core GR standards
• AT&T
• Ciena
• Organized
• Microsoft application proficient
• Web based application proficient

title: Fiber Characterization Technician
description:
Summary:
 
 A Fiber Characterization (FC) Technician will be experienced in all aspects of fiber optic testing and network troubleshooting. Responsible for all aspects of the field-testing process under the direction of a Technical Lead. Provides continuous updates to the TL & Project Manager about milestones; arriving on site, completing work, departing a site, etc., plus progress on the overall project and information which needs to be relayed to the customer. An FC Technician will be personally responsible for maintaining his/her respective certifications and test tools.
 
Major Responsibilities / Duties

  • Manage all Test Equipment which has been assigned to the project.
  • Ensure that all assigned test equipment is current on calibration.
  • Writing and presenting daily reports to the TL for customers’ reference.
  • Assigning specific tasks to subordinates (B-side technician) and monitoring their work ethics for efficiency, quality, and safety.
  • Supervise all starts, breaks, and quitting time.
  • Responsible for the accuracy in the test results of each technician by verifying data from opposite end before leaving the site.
  • Must coordinate the timing and procedures of testing with B side.
  • Perform testing within the customer’s approved window.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of all the final paperwork required and turned over to the customer in a timely manner.
  • Completes quality assurance procedure and check the final reports for errors.
  • Ensure the safety, quality, and efficiencies of our crew.
  • Interfaces with customer contacts on projects and work orders.
  • Provides technical support for customer contacts and Technicians on request.
  • Attends project planning and progress meetings with or without the customer contacts assigned.
  • Understands, adheres to, and promotes the Environmental, Health & Safety policies of Telecommunication standards.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Position Qualifications / Requirements
  • Must possess a valid US Driver’s License.
  • High school or equivalent. Vocational/Technical Business School desired.
  • Think critically and problem solve.
  • Handle confidential/sensitive information with discretion.
  • Good judgment.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Customer service skills.
  • Must have color vision and good hearing.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Vendor Specific Software.
  • Strong technical aptitude.
  • Minimum of 2 years telecommunications training and/or experience.
  • Must have demonstrated proficiency and profitability at Fiber Characterization Technician (A & B) sides.
Work Requirements
  • Proficient use of all tools.
    • Exfo OTDR, iOLM
    • Power meter
    • Fiber scope
    • FastReporter
    • Launch reels
    • Fiber cleaning tools
  • Use of Microsoft Office.
  • General testing knowledge required. (Ex. Fibers, COWAN, BTAS, etc.)
  • Good understanding of Exfo OTDR use A & B sides
  • Good understanding of Chromatic Dispersion, Polarization Mode Dispersion, and ORL.
  • EXFO Platforms FTB-200, FTB-1, FTB-4, FTB-500 (or later chassis)
  • USB flash drive
  • Fiber cleaning system (e.g., wet clean, Cletop, one-click, etc.)
  • Must be able to adhere to a strict schedule and timelines.
  • Must be able to interface and communicate directly with the local customer to ensure site access.
  • Prolonged standing/sitting
  • Climbing of stairs, ladders.
  • Carrying of loads up and down stairs.
  • Reaching and/or grasping.
  • Stopping, walking, kneeling, bending, crawling, and crouching.
  • Carrying, pushing and/or pulling.
  • Finger and wrist dexterity and hand/eye coordination.
  • Exposure to mechanical, electrical, and/or other hazards.

description:

title: Level 4 Installer
description:
Level 4 Installers:

1. Have a minimum of 3 years accumulated experience or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process and demonstrated to the TC representative upon request, proficiency in the system (Network Elements 1, 2, 3, and 4) being worked on, or hold a Certificate of Completion from a training facility providing an appropriate curriculum.
2. Be capable of performing the same work operations/job activities as a Skill Level 3 Installer without supervision or direction.
3. Be capable of performing as the Installation Supplier's in-charge person.
4. Be capable of performing additions, removals, and modifications on working equipment and circuits. Skill Level 4 work operations/job activities may include:
• Circuit modifications
• Software additions or upgrades
• Power transition work
• Addition or removal of batteries.
5. Addition or removal of circuits on working power distribution sources.
6. Equipment testing and turn-up

Requirements:
1. Must understand and know how to use Microsoft programs and applications on a PC and smart device.
2. Must understand Ethernet and Serial connection requirements and be able to establish PC to Network Elements communications using appropriate interface cable.
3. Must have a smart phone with picture capabilities and the ability to place applications used for work.
4. Must have a smart phone with "Mobile Hotspot” capabilities and the ability to establish smart phone to PC connections for the purpose of assisting with remote support via desktop sharing.
5. Must be able to work alone and with others in a fast-paced schedule.
6. Must be able to take direction and constructive criticism.
7. Must be able to think freely and overcome complex issues.
8. Ability to learn to run scripts and commands for test and turn-up of equipment.
9. Must be able to learn company and customer programs for data collection.
10. Must have the ability to fly and ability to travel 100% for 3 consecutive weeks or more with field breaks as the company needs allow.
11. Must pass criminal and drug tests to gain access badging from the telco customer.
12. Must be able to interface politely with the customer using proper work ethics and etiquette while working under pressure.
13. Must have the ability and aptitude to meet customer start and stop working hours.
14. Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces.
15. Must have their own telecom insulated hand tools. (See required tool kits below)
16. Must know how to use telecom test equipment tools. a. OTDR
b. Fiber scope
c. Volt Ohm Meter
d. BER test sets
e. Cable test equipment
f. Visual Fault Locator (Ruby reds)
17. Understanding of proper cabling installation and protection techniques.
18. Understanding industry standards for securing cables using waxed 9-cord and Velcro.
19. Understanding of proper fiber types, ends, jumper/JPOI handling and protection.
20. Understanding of proper fiber cleaning and scoping techniques. (Will NOT be required to splice)
21. Knowledge and understanding of DWDM, OME long haul, short haul, up to 100G circuits.
22. Knowledge and understanding of Transport protocols Ethernet and OTN.
23. Knowledge and understanding of mounting equipment in customer central offices, colocation areas, huts, and outdoor enclosures.
24. Ability to make and test Cat-5/6 cables straight and crossover.
25. Ability to see Understand the telecom color codes and wire wrap paired cable.
26. Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering documents, customer best practices, and manufacturer technical practices. a. Scope of work
b. Cable run lists
c. Rack Face View (RFV) drawing
d. Signal Flow Diagram (SFD)
e. Circuit drawings
f. Installation instructions
g. Method Of Procedures (MOP) (E-MOPs)
27. Knowledge of AC and DC power. a. Power Bays, verifying and installing -48V and return leads while protecting live circuits.
b. Must be able to properly strip and crimp DC power leads.
c. Crimping of lugs and H-Taps.
d. Ability to terminate power safely.
e. Use of electrical grease where required.
f. Use of double insulated torque wrench and screwdriver.
g. Able to work steadily in an enclosed power environment.
h. Understanding of AC power and connections.
28. Knowledge of Telcordia GR1275 industry installation standards.
29. Telco equipment manufacturer and customer knowledge is a plus. a. Ciena
b. Cisco
c. Telecommunication
d. Comcast
e. Telecommunication
f. Enterprise customers
g. GCN customers
h. Etc.

title: Quality Auditor
description:
Position Summary
Inspects, reports, and maintains independent analysis of customer installation projects. Inspection includes physical installation of telecommunication and transport equipment. Review and report quality of all Engineering Specifications & Installation packages to ensure that they are consistent with and meet all requirements of the customer. This is accomplished by performing audits during installation of the package and immediately after job end. Audits include all aspects of project from engineering and installation. The goal is to find and report issues so that a superior product is delivered to the customer.

This is considered a 100% travel throughout the US.
May require weekend work at times.
Telecom Quality inspection knowledge is a must.
5 plus years of telecom installation experience.
3 plus years of quality auditing experience. 

Major Responsibility
• Interprets Customer Standards / Practices, T-BASD Drawings, Flashes and Manufacturers and understands documentation of the National Electric Code, and other industry standard documents.
• Ensures engineering specification, assignments, and job drawings are in accordance with specifications and that proper documentation is provided.
• Audits engineering documentation and installation workmanship to ensure accuracy of the information presented.
• Develops a list of deltas for correction and verifies completed corrections per company standards.
• Audit customer job site on request, visually inspect pictures that have been uploaded to ensure that customer standards are met. Verify job spec information and documentation is properly and accurately collected and conveyed when necessary.
• Ability to be at the job site to audit installed equipment to ensure that customer standards are met.
• Must be AT&T certified or able to pass their tests to become certified.
• Knowledge of Ciena, Cisco, and other telecom equipment installation.
• Ability to train technicians while performing installation inspection.

Position Qualification / Requirements
• Computer skills, including Microsoft Office and other software applications.
• 3M & Hilti Fire Stop Certification or knowledge.
• Ability to fly or operate a motor vehicle, possess valid US Driver's License, and maintain an approved Motor Vehicle Record.
• Knowledge of Telecommunications and transport equipment installation.
• Handle confidential/sensitive information with discretion.
• Excellent communication & good judgment.
• Organizational skills.
• Customer service skills.
• Interpersonal skills.
• Knowledge of equipment installation, detail engineering, COAR, site survey, knowledge and understanding of power, grounding, and Telephony theory.
Key Words
• Telecommunications Quality
• Telecom Installation Quality
• Telcordia Bell core GR standards
• AT&T
• Ciena
• Organized
• Microsoft application proficient
• Web based application proficient

title: Network Planning Engineer (Telecom Circuit Design)
description:
Network Planning Engineer (Telecom Circuit Design)

Resources will be required to work on client's site in Melbourne, FL.  Non-local candidates will be compensated accordingly for long-term assignment in Melbourne.

Job Description:

A Network Planning Engineer’s (Telco Engineer) role will be a crucial part in evaluating, planning, and implementing a cutting-edge telecommunications network design tailored to mission-critical needs. You will be at the forefront of replacing legacy copper-based systems with advanced technologies, creating scalable and optimized telco architectures, and documenting solutions that support engineering and NOC operations. Collaborate with internal and external teams, work independently on high-impact projects, and lead proof-of-concept efforts for emerging services.

Essential Functions:
  • Assess telecommunications technologies and design solutions to ensure alignment with the network’s critical infrastructure and service requirements.
  • Architect and engineer next-generation telco services to replace legacy copper-based solutions with modern, scalable alternatives.
  • Deliver tailored network implementations that meet dynamic customer requirements and long-term strategic objectives.
  • Establish and apply best practices in network design, capacity planning, and service continuity to support mission-critical operations.
  • Oversee the telco design release lifecycle to ensure timely execution and alignment with program milestones.

  • Responsibilities:

    a. Evaluate telco designs in relation to the critical infrastructure and service needs for the FTI network.
    b. Plan and design modern telco services to replace legacy copper-based telco solutions.
    c. Implement solutions that support customer requirements.
    d. Participate in after action reviews to resolve technical challenges.
    e. Create and maintain documentation for engineering and NOC teams.
    f. Identify areas of opportunity for automation and network optimization.
    g. Manage the Telco design release workflow to meet the implementation schedule.

    Required Qualifications:

    a. Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems or equivalent of a 4-year accredited degree in a technical discipline
    b. Degree and minimum 4 years of prior WAN Telecommunications networks experience or 2 years post-Secondary/ Associates Degree and a minimum of 8 years of prior WAN Telecommunications networks experience
    c. Highly motivated and capable of developing and following detailed instructions and action plans.
    d. Ability to work in a team environment and is self-directed and self-motivated.
    e. Project management skills capable of adhering to deadlines and completing tasks per project schedule.
    f. Strong skill set with Microsoft Office software applications.
    g. Knowledge and understanding of engineering drawings and technical procedures.
    h. Domain knowledge of the Telecommunications industry, including carrier services, provisioning terminology, CISCO routers and network infrastructure and IP technologies such as Pseudo Wire and Ethernet switching.
    i. Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance security clearance.

    Preferred Additional Qualifications:

    a. Experience designing and implementing network technologies such as SONET, Carrier Ethernet, LTE...etc.
    b. Must be able to demonstrate the ability to design, implement and support Ethernet and TDM network infrastructures.
    c. Knowledge of IP technologies such as Pseudo Wire and Ethernet switching
    d. Knowledge of telecommunications carrier ordering systems and processes
    e. Knowledge of WAN/LAN, TDM and Voice switching systems; TCP/IP, specific routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP and RIP; VoIP, DWDM, CTI and VPN technologies
    f. Experience with leading network vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, RAD
    g. Experience with database modeling software such as MetaSolv     network infrastructures.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications carrier ordering systems and processes.
  • Experience with database modeling software such as MetaSolv.

title: Telecom Circuit Testing Engineer (Service Activation Engineer)
description:
Telecom Circuit Testing Engineer (Service Activation Engineer)

Contract Position (W-2, no C2C)
Must be able to obtain Security Clearance

Description:
In this role, you will support supervision of equipment and service order installation and activation. The candidate will collaborate with internal and external teams and work independently implementing scheduled network maintenance events. Other tasks include managing special projects supporting program requirements.
Essential Functions:

  • Execute and document formal acceptance testing of products and services per program requirements
  • Knowledge of Telecommunications equipment installation, configuration and testing standards including TDM, PDH, SDH, SONET, and IP network architecture
  • Possess an intermediate (CCNA certification, or equivalent experience) level of experience troubleshooting IP network configurations.
  • Domain knowledge of data protocols including TCP/IP, DMVPN, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EIGRP, HSRP, IS-IS, LDP, PIM, MSDP, and Ethernet.
  • Strong customer interface skills supporting coordination of both Telco providers and Harris field technician site access as required
  • Test, troubleshoot, and validate communication circuits per IEEE, ITU, TIA, ISO specifications
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering team members to resolve implementation and acceptance issues as needed
  • Responsible to execute a coordinated Maintenance Request (MR) activity to support, Engineering changes per customer and program requirements.
  • Responsible for executing services disconnects throughout the establish Network / CPE per customer and program request via establish program disconnect process.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
  • Previous Network experience
  • Prefer 3 or more years’ experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms
  • Ability to obtain a Security Clearance
Preferred Additional Skills:
  • Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures
  • Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types
  • Have a thorough understanding of trouble tickets, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures
  • Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart
  • Experience with MetaSolv and DICE preferred
  • MEF-CECP certification preferred

title: Optical Transport Engineer (IXC)
description:
Optical Transport Engineer (IXC)

Contract Position (W-2, no C2C)
Must be able to obtain Security Clearance
 
Job Description:
As a Network Engineer, you will support the management and implementation of IP network solutions, collaborate with internal and external teams and work independently on projects from start to finish. This includes developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and full implementation follow-through and documentation of requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
  • Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design (MetaSolv/DICE) and operations (FINS, FMS, etc.) toolsets and ensure FTI-POP design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
  • Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
  • Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct Harris field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment, and circuits.
  • Work directly with Telco Carrier field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
  • Follow MetaSolv/DICE workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes, and/or disconnects as needed.
  • Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g., RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
  • Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
  • Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
  • Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
  • Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
  • Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
  • Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
  • Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
  • Prefer 3 or more years’ experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms
  • Ability to obtain security clearance.
Preferred Additional Skills:
  • Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures
  • Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types
  • Have a thorough understanding of trouble tickets, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures
  • Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart
  • Experience with MetaSolv and DICE preferred
  • MEF-CECP certification preferred

title: Optical Transport Engineer (IXC)
description:
Optical Transport Engineer (IXC)
 
Job Description:
As a Network Engineer, you will support the management and implementation of IP network solutions, collaborate with internal and external teams and work independently on projects from start to finish. This includes developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and full implementation follow-through and documentation of requirements.
 
Essential Functions:

  • Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
  • Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design (MetaSolv/DICE) and operations (FINS, FMS, etc.) toolsets and ensure FTI-POP design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
  • Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
  • Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct Harris field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment, and circuits.
  • Work directly with Telco Carrier field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
  • Follow MetaSolv/DICE workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes, and/or disconnects as needed.
  • Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g., RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
  • Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
  • Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
  • Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
  • Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
  • Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
  • Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.

title: Telecom Circuit Activation/Testing Engineer

Telecom Circuit Activation/Testing Engineer
 
Resources will be required to work on client's site in Melbourne, FL.  Non-local candidates will be compensated accordingly for long-term assignment in Melbourne.

Description:
In this role, you will support supervision of equipment and service order installation and activation. The candidate will collaborate with internal and external teams and work independently implementing scheduled network maintenance events. Other tasks include managing special projects supporting program requirements.
Essential Functions:

  • Execute and document formal acceptance testing of products and services per program requirements
  • Knowledge of Telecommunications equipment installation, configuration and testing standards including TDM, PDH, SDH, SONET, and IP network architecture
  • Possess an intermediate (CCNA certification, or equivalent experience) level of experience troubleshooting IP network configurations.
  • Domain knowledge of data protocols including TCP/IP, DMVPN, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EIGRP, HSRP, IS-IS, LDP, PIM, MSDP, and Ethernet.
  • Strong customer interface skills supporting coordination of both Telco providers and Harris field technician site access as required
  • Test, troubleshoot, and validate communication circuits per IEEE, ITU, TIA, ISO specifications
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering team members to resolve implementation and acceptance issues as needed
  • Responsible to execute a coordinated Maintenance Request (MR) activity to support, Engineering changes per customer and program requirements.
  • Responsible for executing services disconnects throughout the establish Network / CPE per customer and program request via establish program disconnect process.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
  • Previous Network experience
  • Prefer 3 or more years’ experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance
Preferred Additional Skills:
  • Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures
  • Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types
  • Have a thorough understanding of trouble tickets, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures
  • Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart
  • Experience with MetaSolv and DICE preferred
  • MEF-CECP certification preferred

title: Optical Transport Engineer (IXC)
description:
Optical Transport Engineer (IXC)

Resources will be required to work on client's site in Melbourne, FL.  Non-local candidates will be compensated accordingly for long-term assignment in Melbourne.


Job Description:
As a Network Engineer, you will support the management and implementation of IP network solutions, collaborate with internal and external teams and work independently on projects from start to finish. This includes developing network designs based on user requirements, creating network diagrams using Visio, configuring network equipment, and full implementation follow-through and documentation of requirements.
Essential Functions:

  • Work directly with IXC Deployment Team, IXC Engineering, Telco design engineers, and Telco Carrier Provisioning personnel to accurately document circuit designs.
  • Ensure Carrier HUBs and circuits are accurately recorded in design (MetaSolv/DICE) and operations (FINS, FMS, etc.) toolsets and ensure FTI-POP design documentation accurately reflects as-built configurations.
  • Document design deviations and/or discrepancies and submit ClearQuest PTRs to capture design changes and/or corrections with circuit designs.
  • Support scheduled planned maintenance events (Moves, Adds, Changes) and direct Harris field technicians with the installation and activation of SONET, ancillary equipment, and circuits.
  • Work directly with Telco Carrier field technicians to isolate and resolve issues with new circuit activations.
  • Follow MetaSolv/DICE workflow processes and update IXC circuit database during IXC circuit installations, activation, changes, and/or disconnects as needed.
  • Provision IXC circuits using Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) or Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) and configure ancillary equipment for delivery of sub-rate circuits (e.g., RAD RICi-16/EGATE-100, Cisco ASR1002/1001-X router port configurations including T3/T1 SIP/SPA, DNX-11/88 port configurations, etc.).
  • Ensure circuits are provisioned IAW circuit design documentation and resolve discrepancies before circuits are released to the customer.
  • Interface directly with internal and external customers and provide technical assistance with service activation and circuit verification testing.
  • Monitor and identify optical network alarms and proactively investigate and identify the root cause to minimize disruption and impact to operational circuits.
  • Provide recommendations for improving processes and procedures and assist in the maintenance and upgrades of controlled documentation.
  • Support scheduled maintenance events during normal operating hours and after hours/weekends as needed.
  • Assist in the collection of data needed to perform analysis of network issues.
  • Assist with the execution of test procedures and provide feedback to ensure procedural steps are correct.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
  • Prefer 3 or more years’ experience working with SONET equipment and Optical Circuits. Specifically, with Cisco ONS-15310, ONS-15454 and Fujitsu Flashwave 4500/9500 platforms
  • Ability to obtain security clearance.
Preferred Additional Skills:
  • Have a thorough understanding of NAS Operations ticket management and scheduled maintenance processes and procedures
  • Possess a strong technical understanding of Gigabit Ethernet/Fast Ethernet, DS1/T1, DS3, VT1.5, VTV, STS1, STSV and OC3-OC192 circuit types as well as familiarity with existing processes and procedures associated in provisioning and acceptance testing of these circuit types
  • Have a thorough understanding of trouble tickets, ticket management, and Change Management processes and procedures
  • Experience with Cisco Prime Optical (CPO) and Cisco Transport Controller (CTC) Fujitsu NetSmart
  • Experience with MetaSolv and DICE preferred
  • MEF-CECP certification preferred

title: Network Planning Engineer (Telecom Circuit Design)
description:
Network Planning Engineer (Telecom Circuit Design)

Resources will be required to work on client's site in Melbourne, FL.  Non-local candidates will be compensated accordingly for long-term assignment in Melbourne.

Job Description:

A Network Planning Engineer’s (Telco Engineer) role will be a crucial part in evaluating, planning, and implementing a cutting-edge telecommunications network design tailored to mission-critical needs. You will be at the forefront of replacing legacy copper-based systems with advanced technologies, creating scalable and optimized telco architectures, and documenting solutions that support engineering and NOC operations. Collaborate with internal and external teams, work independently on high-impact projects, and lead proof-of-concept efforts for emerging services.

Essential Functions:
  • Assess telecommunications technologies and design solutions to ensure alignment with the network’s critical infrastructure and service requirements.
  • Architect and engineer next-generation telco services to replace legacy copper-based solutions with modern, scalable alternatives.
  • Deliver tailored network implementations that meet dynamic customer requirements and long-term strategic objectives.
  • Establish and apply best practices in network design, capacity planning, and service continuity to support mission-critical operations.
  • Oversee the telco design release lifecycle to ensure timely execution and alignment with program milestones.

  • Responsibilities:

    a. Evaluate telco designs in relation to the critical infrastructure and service needs for the FTI network.
    b. Plan and design modern telco services to replace legacy copper-based telco solutions.
    c. Implement solutions that support customer requirements.
    d. Participate in after action reviews to resolve technical challenges.
    e. Create and maintain documentation for engineering and NOC teams.
    f. Identify areas of opportunity for automation and network optimization.
    g. Manage the Telco design release workflow to meet the implementation schedule.

    Required Qualifications:

    a. Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems or equivalent of a 4-year accredited degree in a technical discipline
    b. Degree and minimum 4 years of prior WAN Telecommunications networks experience or 2 years post-Secondary/ Associates Degree and a minimum of 8 years of prior WAN Telecommunications networks experience
    c. Highly motivated and capable of developing and following detailed instructions and action plans.
    d. Ability to work in a team environment and is self-directed and self-motivated.
    e. Project management skills capable of adhering to deadlines and completing tasks per project schedule.
    f. Strong skill set with Microsoft Office software applications.
    g. Knowledge and understanding of engineering drawings and technical procedures.
    h. Domain knowledge of the Telecommunications industry, including carrier services, provisioning terminology, CISCO routers and network infrastructure and IP technologies such as Pseudo Wire and Ethernet switching.
    i. Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance security clearance.

    Preferred Additional Qualifications:

    a. Experience designing and implementing network technologies such as SONET, Carrier Ethernet, LTE...etc.
    b. Must be able to demonstrate the ability to design, implement and support Ethernet and TDM network infrastructures.
    c. Knowledge of IP technologies such as Pseudo Wire and Ethernet switching
    d. Knowledge of telecommunications carrier ordering systems and processes
    e. Knowledge of WAN/LAN, TDM and Voice switching systems; TCP/IP, specific routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP and RIP; VoIP, DWDM, CTI and VPN technologies
    f. Experience with leading network vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, RAD
    g. Experience with database modeling software such as MetaSolv    network infrastructures.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications carrier ordering systems and processes.
  • Experience with database modeling software such as MetaSolv.
